title: Senior Systems Engineer, C2 Networking, Edge Compute and Communications
description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE JOB

Our team develops unmanned aerial systems capable of terminal guidance, long range intelligence collection, precision navigation, and unsupervised autonomy. Anvil, Altius, Ghost, and other developmental UAS platforms are built to operate in remote environments with limited user input, driving requirements for reliability and autonomy. We have developed an autonomy stack that receives user intent, responds to detections processed at the edge, and coordinates flight patterns for groups of assets. We want systems engineers with experience in this field to help design and manage the next generation of Anduril’s flight vehicles. In order to succeed at Anduril, a systems engineer needs to be familiar with simulation and rapid prototyping development to drive complex electro-mechanical and aero-performance design trades, in addition to supporting the engineering product development, production, and sustainment through the entire product lifecycle.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

• Enable UAS C2 capabilities through resilient network design

• Derive system/subsystem/component level requirements

• Design, develop, and maintain system components that meet functional and performance requirements in complex system environments

• Conduct thorough testing and debugging to ensure the reliability, scalability, and resilience of software applications, especially within a distributed systems context

• Work closely with hardware engineers and product managers to ensure seamless integration of software and hardware components

• Collaborate with the team to define and document software engineering processes and practices, ensuring adherence to quality standards and regulatory requirements

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• A sincere commitment to a positive, inclusive, and collaborative culture, and a passion for systems development, integration, and testing

• 8+ years experience as a network engineer that highlights your ability to execute complex engineering level tasks as an individual and part of a team

• Expert level knowledge of multicast and supporting protocols IGMP & PIM

• Expert level knowledge of unicast and supporting protocols OSPF & BGP

• Experience with end to end testing of both unicast and multicast data flows

• Experience with Quality of Service and CBWFQ

• Advanced knowledge of Linux based operating systems

• Hands on experience with networking design, test and operation of communications systems for Line of Sight (LOS) and Beyond Line of Sight (BLOS)

• Proficiency in test script development using common languages (Python, Matlab etc)

• Excellent verbal & written communication skills

• Must hold a U.S. Secret security clearance

• Ability to travel domestically up to 50% as needed to support various efforts, and excitement to work onsite at our headquarters in Costa Mesa, CA the majority of the time!

Preferred Qualifications:

• Familiarity with End to End RF Integration with, but not limited to, Unmanned Aerial Systems

• Hands on experience with tactical radios

$180,000 — $220,000 USD

title: Supply Chain Planner - Packaging (f/m/x)
description:
The role: What's in the Box

As a Supply Chain Planner, you will join our Operational Procurement team to help manage the cycle of purchasing the packaging ingredients that compose our HelloFresh boxes. This is a hands-on role where you independently oversee the end-to-end ordering process, from delivery scheduling and shortage management to driving improvements in supplier performance.

You will act as a primary point of contact for our partners, ensuring that every shipment meets our standards for quality and timing. Your day-to-day focus centers on hitting clear performance targets, specifically maintaining high OTIFIQ (On Time, In Full, In Quality) levels while actively working to reduce error rates and waste. We are looking for a practical problem-solver who enjoys taking ownership of a fast-moving process and contributing to a more efficient, sustainable supply chain.

What you’ll do: The Recipe

• Operational buyer : Manage the end-to-end purchase order process for your assigned supplier portfolio, ensuring timely and accurate deliveries.

• Coordinate: Coordinate  daily with suppliers, production, and internal stakeholders to resolve shortages, quality issues, and delivery deviations

• Operational Point of Contact: Serve as the primary link between suppliers and our production, product and FSQA teams to coordinate all planning activities and operational matters. Ensuring enablement and performance tracking of new ingredients (planning frequency, errors & waste) as well as product substitution management

• Relationship Development:  Build and maintain collaborative, long-term partnerships with our supplier base through the onboarding process, supplier performance reviews, supplier visits and regular contact.

• Process Optimization: Identify and implement practical improvements to refine our supply chain workflows and increase efficiency. Support with projects from other teams or within your category.

• Reporting : You own your KPI’s and ensure that targets are met, perform rootcause analysis and preventive actions and present this in WBR’s. You flag structural challenge, follow-up with suppliers/internal teams to prevent situations from happening again

• Order Accuracy:  Monitor forecast & order flows closely to maintain high service levels and minimize discrepancies in the supply chain.

What you’ll bring: The Ingredients

• Educational Background: Degree in Supply Chain, Business, or a related field.

• Professional Experience: 2+ years of relevant experience, ideally within a fast-paced supply chain environment.

• Analytical Skills: Strong proficiency in Excel; you are comfortable using data to track performance and inform your decisions.

• Agility: A quick learner who adapts easily to new processes and remains solution-oriented when priorities shift.

• Operational Rigor: Highly organized and detail-oriented, with a disciplined approach to managing complex ordering schedules.

• Proactivity: The ability to anticipate potential issues and react effectively to unexpected supply chain challenges.

• Communication: Fluency in English (written and spoken).

Above all, we are looking for people who will make HelloFresh better. There are many different ways of developing skills, and we love diverse experiences! So even if you don’t “tick all the boxes” but think you’d thrive in this role, we would really like to learn more about you.

Are you the missing ingredient? If this sounds like a tasty opportunity, we’d be excited to hear from you. We aim to review your profile and respond within 5 business days.

Kako bi izgledao tvoj rad na ovoj poziciji:

• Kada je klijentu potreban savet i kontaktira nas putem digitalnih kanala - ti bi bio/la prva osoba sa kojom bi stupili u kontakt

• Odlično govoriš i pišeš nemački jezik - ovo je važno kako bismo dobro razumeli klijenta i adekvatno odgovorili na njihovo pitanje ili brigu

• Komunikativan/a si i empatičan/na - ovo su važne osobine za uspešnu komunikaciju sa klijentom

• Odgovornost i orijentisanost na rešenje su osobine koje te odlikuju - važno je da imamo ažurnu i uspešnu komunikaciju sa klijentima

• Rad na računaru ti nije stran - sva komunikacija sa korisnicima se odigrava putem računara

Kako izgleda život u Transcom u?

U Transcom u smo neumorno posvećeni. Našim klijentima i jedni drugima. Svakog dana neko započne svoje putovanje sa Transcom om. Uzimajući potencijal koji imaju danas i pretvarajući ga u veštine za budućnost. Dobijanje priznanja za naporan rad, timskog igrača i podršku drugima. Zagovaranje pozitivnih, trajnih promena u svojim timovima i zajednicama. Takvi smo mi u Transcom u. Ovde nam je stalo, i navijamo jedni za druge. Uključeni ste, baš takvi kakvi jeste, od prvog dana. A sa pravim načinom razmišljanja, nema granice koliko daleko možemo ići zajedno.

Canary Technologies is the leading agentic AI platform for hotel and guest management, powering the digital infrastructure for more than 20,000 hotels in 125+ countries. The world's most renowned hospitality brands, including Marriott International, Four Seasons and Wyndham Hotels & Resorts, partner with us to increase revenue, improve operations and elevate the guest experience.
We’ve executed the largest deployment of autonomous AI systems in hospitality, building technology that fundamentally redefines how guests and hotels interact. It’s made us one of the top-funded hotel technology companies in the world, with nearly $200M raised to date.
Canary has been recognized as a 2024 and 2025 Deloitte Technology Fast 500™ company, Inc. 5000 fastest-growing company, and swept the 2026 HotelTechAwards, including Best Place to Work, #1 Guest Experience Platform, and the Hotelier’s Choice Award. We're growing quickly, and we're looking for people who are passionate about their work, want to grow with us and are ready to take on more responsibility along the way. Come join us! Let’s shape the future of hospitality together.

 

About the Role
We are looking for a Kiosk Implementation Specialist to be the cornerstone of our Kiosk activation strategy across the EMEA region, leading on-site deployments at hotels throughout Europe, the Middle East, and Africa. Your deep understanding of hotel operations will be invaluable as you analyze reservation data to ensure our kiosks handle every scenario - from simple walk-ins to complex group blocks with routing rules.

title: Technical Implementation Specialist
description:
About MD Integrations

At MD Integrations , we partner with digital health brands to power clinical care at scale. We specialize in men's and women’s health, dermatology, endocrinology, and weight management, offering telehealth solutions that help patients receive expert, personalized care-all from the comfort of their home. Join our team and be part of the movement to make specialty care more accessible and impactful.

MD Integrations is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We are unable to support US visa sponsorship at this time.

The Technical Implementation Specialist is the central point of contact and technical liaison for MDI customers in active implementation and supporting existing customers as they expand their integration offerings. You’ll lead the technical implementation process from kickoff to go-live, mapping and configuring API connections, reviewing logs, and troubleshooting issues to keep integrations on track.

This role is ideal for someone technically literate and highly comfortable working with APIs who enjoys problem-solving, learning new systems, and explaining complex concepts clearly to non-technical customers. This is not a software engineering role: you won’t be writing production code, but you will need to be confident configuring, testing, and debugging API connections independently. You’ll partner closely with the partner success and engineering teams, escalating clearly documented issues when they’re beyond the scope of this role.

Key Responsibilities

• Serve as the technical point of contact for new customers throughout implementation, and for existing customers expanding their integration footprint, guiding each engagement from kickoff through go-live.

• Lead the end-to-end technical implementation process, mapping and configuring API connections with customers and validating setup over screen share in real time. The average implementation timeline is days, not months.

• Monitor logs, dashboards, and tools like Postman to identify when APIs are misconfigured or behaving unexpectedly, and independently resolve the majority of issues without engineering involvement.

• Draft clear technical documentation for each issue encountered, including root cause, steps taken, and resolution, to build a reliable internal record and knowledge base.

• Escalate unresolved or complex issues to engineering with well-documented context, ensuring a smooth handoff and minimal back-and-forth.

• Translate customer inquiries and data needs into clear technical tasks and configuration notes, acting as the bridge between customer expectations and technical execution.

• Partner with the Partner Success Managers and Clinical Support teams to align technical capabilities with customer expectations throughout the relationship.

• Identify recurring issues or friction points across implementations and recommend ways to simplify, document, or automate the process.

• Maintain a high level of responsiveness, ownership, and customer empathy across both the finite implementation period and ongoing expansion work.

Success Looks Like…

• Quick integration timelines driving a seamless go-live.

• High customer satisfaction scores during integration and beyond.

• Low number of escalations needing hands-on engineering resources.

• Accuracy and completeness of documentation.

• Responsiveness and collaboration across technical and customer teams.

Required Qualifications

• 3+ years’ experience in a customer-facing technical support or implementation role with an emphasis on API-driven applications. Must be comfortable working with customers’ technical teams live, troubleshooting on video calls.

• Strong understanding of APIs, webhooks, JSON payloads, and HTTP status codes; comfortable reading logs and API documentation to identify root cause and resolve configuration issues without engineering support.

• Familiarity with data map

Vous rejoindrez l'équipe Doctolib Prévention , une équipe d'entrepreneur(euse)s qui construit une nouvelle activité depuis 2022 avec l'ambition de transformer le système de santé vers plus de prévention. 

Il existe trois formes de prévention : primaire (de l’exercice physique à la nutrition, la lutte contre les addictions ou encore la vaccination), secondaire (limiter l’impact de la maladie sur la santé à travers le dépistage du cancer du sein, de l’utérus…), et tertiaire (l’ensemble des moyens mis en œuvre pour éviter la survenue de complications et de rechutes pour les personnes atteintes de maladies chroniques). La France est bonne élève sur la prévention tertiaire, très curative, mais en retard sur la prévention primaire et secondaire, par rapport à d’autres pays européens.

• Pour les patients : notre objectif est de leur donner les moyens de devenir acteurs de leur santé avec une approche préventive, en commençant par leur offrir une information de qualité et la capacité d’agir simplement lors des campagnes de prévention nationales

• Pour les professionnels de santé : notre objectif est de leur fournir les outils adéquats pour réussir le virage vers une médecine plus préventive, en commençant par fournir une information de qualité sur l’accompagnement des patients lors des campagnes de prévention nationales

• Nous avons relayé plus d’une centaine de campagnes depuis notre lancement, en prévention primaire et secondaire (facteurs de risque, vaccination, dépistages, santé mentale…) avec des acteurs institutionnels (Santé Publique France, CNAM, Ministères…), associatifs et privés (eg : L’Oréal, MSD etc). Les campagnes sont relayées auprès de millions de Français avec un bel impact en termes de passage à l’action.

Vos responsabilités incluent, mais ne sont pas limitées à :

• Contrats : Rédaction des contrats en utilisant les modèles fournis par l'équipe Legal, Suivi des contrats, y compris la mise à disposition des contrats et la gestion des signatures

• Facturation : Suivi de la facturation, y compris la création de factures ainsi que le suivi des règlements

• Data et suivi de performance : Suivi quotidien de la performance des campagnes en cours et amélioration continue en lien avec le marketing, préparation des présentations clients, notamment les réunions de brief et le partage des résultats de campagnes et analyses ad hoc : benchmark de performance par cible, analyse des AB test pour optimiser la performance de nos campagnes

Ez a pozíció kiváló ugródeszka a további vezetői fejlődéshez a gyorsan növekvő e-kereskedelmi szektorban.

Miért izgalmas ez a pozíció?

- Valódi felelősség és hatás: Egy teljes operatív terület működéséért, biztonságáért és teljesítményéért felelsz, döntéseid azonnal meglátszanak az eredményekben.

- Közvetlen csapatépítés: Nemcsak irányítod, hanem fejleszted is a munkatársakat, alakítva a felelősségteljes és elkötelezett kultúrát.

- Folyamatos fejlődési lehetőség: Egy dinamikusan skálázódó, modern logisztikai környezetben léphetsz előre a vezetői karrierlétrán.

- Keresztfunkcionális együttműködés: Szorosan együttdolgozol a munkavédelmi, automatizációs, HR, IT és folyamatfejlesztési csapattal.

- Problémamegoldás élesben: Nem sablonos feladataid lesznek; a napi operatív kihívásokat feltárod, és fenntartható megoldásokat vezetsz be.

Mi lesz a feladatod

- Irányítod és biztosítod az adott terület napi operatív működését, elerve a biztonsági, minőségi és termelékenységi mutatókat (KPI-ok).

- Vezeted, motiválod és fejleszted a területen dolgozó munkatársakat.

- Támogatod a biztonsági kultúrát: példamutatással, proaktív beavatkozásokkal és rendszeres auditokkal garantálod a munkavédelmi szabályok betartását.

- Elemzed az operatív problémák kiváltó okait, és hosszú távú, hatékony megoldásokat léptetsz életbe.

- Aktívan hozzájárulsz a munkaerő-tervezéshez, a folyamatok optimalizálásához és a hatékonyságnövelő kezdeményezésekhez.

- Szorosan együttműködsz a társfőosztályokkal (automatizáció, karbantartás, operációs kiválóság, pénzügy) a működési akadályok elhárításában.

- Biztosítod a munkaügyi jogszabályok, a belső működési eljárások és a vállalati előírások teljes körű betartását.

Kit keresünk

- Tapasztalat: 1-3 év embereket vezetői, logisztikai, gyártási vagy operációs területen szerzett tapasztalat.

- Vezetői attitűd: Erős határozottság, kiváló kommunikációs készség és képesség a csapatok motiválására dinamikus, gyors tempójú környezetben.

- Adat- és KPI-szemlélet: Otthonosan mozgsz az adatelemzésben, és tudod, hogyan kell a teljesítménymutatókat a gyakorlati működés szolgálatába állítani.

- Nyelvtudás: Kommunikációképes angol nyelvtudás.

- Rugalmasság: A logisztika pörög - nyitottság a több műszakos munkarendre, beleértve a hétvégi és ünnepnapi műszakokat is. (Délelőtt: 04:00-14:15
Délután: 13:30-23:15)

- Iskolai végzettség: Legalább középfokú végzettség (felsőfokú tanulmányok vagy diplomás háttér előny).

Előnyt jelent:

- Felsőfokú végzettség, MBA vagy logisztikai/üzleti képzettség.

- E-kereskedelmi, raktárirányítási (WMS) vagy ellátási lánc környezetben szerzett tapasztalat.

Amit kínálunk:

- Versenyképes jövedelem

- Cafeteria és Kifli Prémium tagság és 10% visszatérítés kreditekben

- Fiatalos, barátságos és vidám csapat

- Folyamatos fejlődési lehetőség scale-up környezetben

title: Gestionnaire de programme technique principal·e - FinOps
description:
Bonjour! Merci de votre visite 👋

L'équipe Operations Produit et Technologie recherche une personne au poste de Gestionnaire de programme technique principal·e pour se joindre à elle et prendre en charge la gestion, l'optimisation et la mise à l'échelle des dépenses liées au nuage, aux fournisseurs et à l'IA à l'échelle de l'organisation.

Vous définirez la stratégie FinOps elle-même - non seulement en gérant un programme de coûts existant, mais en décidant des éléments à optimiser, de l'ordre de priorité et des raisons sous-jacentes. La gestion des coûts liés au nuage et aux fournisseurs s'appuie sur des pratiques établies que nous souhaitons adapter et automatiser; ce n'est pas le cas pour les dépenses en IA. Vous définirez et bâtirez le FinOps pour l'IA, tout en faisant évoluer les pratiques existantes vers un système plus automatisé.

Il s'agit d'un rôle de spécialiste technique de très haut niveau. Vous apporterez une expertise technique suffisante pour concevoir ou façonner directement les automatisations, les tableaux de bord et les recommandations d'optimisation, ainsi qu'un jugement stratégique permettant d'influencer la réflexion de la direction sur les compromis financiers et le partenariat avec les équipes des finances, de l'approvisionnement et d'autres fonctions concernant la gestion et l'optimisation des fournisseurs.

Ce que vous ferez

Définir la stratégie FinOps

- Détenir la responsabilité de la stratégie de gestion des coûts liés au nuage, aux fournisseurs et à l'IA dans l'ensemble de l'organisation - et pas seulement de l'exécution d'une feuille de route existante.

- Réévaluer continuellement les éléments à optimiser, l'ordre des priorités et les raisons motivant ces choix, en fonction de la concentration réelle des dépenses et des risques.

- Bâtir le cadre de gestion des coûts de l'IA, un domaine qui ne dispose pas encore de modèle établi dans l'industrie.

Favoriser l'optimisation des coûts grâce à une expertise technique approfondie

- Analyser l'utilisation du nuage, les contrats des fournisseurs et les dépenses en IA pour cibler les inefficacités et élaborer des stratégies visant à réduire les coûts inutiles.

- Concevoir ou façonner directement les tableaux de bord, les automatisations et les systèmes de surveillance qui rendent les coûts visibles et exploitables, avec une profondeur technique équivalente à celle d'une personne occupant un poste d'ingénierie senior.

- Proposer des optimisations techniques spécifiques, et pas seulement des recommandations de processus, et savoir quand une suggestion nécessite un partenariat d'ingénierie plus poussé.

- Appliquer une expérience pratique dans la création et l'automatisation avec l'IA, au lieu de simplement orienter les autres équipes.

Diriger le programme à l'échelle de l'organisation

- Superviser et, dans certains cas, exécuter simultanément plusieurs initiatives d'optimisation des coûts.

- Prendre en charge la structure de suivi - attribution des coûts, surveillance et alertes - et l'utiliser pour présenter à la direction un bilan clair et fiable des dépenses et des économies.

- Travailler en partenariat avec l'équipe de planification et d'analyse financières (FP&A) pour définir et établir des métriques de coûts clés, offrant à la direction une perspective financière plus précise sur l'efficacité des coûts.

- Gérer les dépendances interfonctionnelles, les risques et le changement au sein des équipes de SRE, d'ingénierie, de données, de FP&A et d'approvisionnement.

Exercer une influence au niveau de la direction

- Présenter des perspectives sur la faisabilité, les échéanciers, les risques et les compromis de coûts directement à la haute direction, afin d'orienter les décisions qui touchent le budget réel et les choix d'infrastructure.

- Équilibrer les normes centralisées de gestion des coûts avec l'autonomie dont les unités d'affaires individuelles ont besoin pour fonctionner efficacement.

- Faire émerger de manière proactive les problèmes

title: Global Lead, Partnerships and Networks
description:
350.org is looking for a Global Lead, Partnerships and Networks who will be responsible for visible and meaningful engagement of a global network of activists, supporters and partners in our national and global campaigns.
About 350.org

350’s mission is to keep carbon in our atmosphere at a safe level, below 350 parts per million. We do this by mobilizing ordinary people to campaign for universal access to clean energy and an end to fossil fuels. Our campaigns are rooted in local organizing, so that while achieving measurable reductions in fossil fuel emissions, we also build the power and potential of the climate movement for yet more impact to come. The values that guide and drive our work are listed here.
350.org is an equal opportunity employer. 350.org strives to be an inclusive and collaborative group of people who bring a variety of approaches to the work we do. We’re committed to the principles of justice, and we try to build a safe workplace where everyone is treated fairly and enjoys working together. We value new perspectives, ideas of all sorts, and different ways of working. Diverse perspectives and experiences improve the way 350.org carries out our work - including what we decide to work on and how creatively/effectively we do that. We do our best to make staff positions accessible to all potential team members, regardless of race, national origin, ethnicity, age, disability, assigned gender, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation or identity, religion or creed, veteran status, marital or parental status, and genetic information. We also strive to include team members in communities most impacted by climate change or impacted by other kinds of environmental, social, and economic injustice.
About the Global Lead, Partnerships and Networks
The Global Lead, Partnerships and Networks is responsible for visible and meaningful engagement of a global network of activists, supporters and partners into our national and global campaigns. This role manages a small distributed team responsible for building powerful, politically effective networks of local groups, volunteers and partners across regions. The role is accountable for setting direction, driving delivery, and ensuring that partnerships and network-building work contributes directly to campaign outcomes, organisational priorities and movement power. This role works closely with Country teams to develop, strengthen and expand partnerships outside the climate justice ecosystem.
Duties and Responsibilities:

• Lead the development of network strategy for partners, allies and local groups that is tailored to context and linked to campaign priorities.

• Ensure systems are in place to track, evaluate, and report on network health, volunteer engagement, and leadership development.

• Bring global and regional insight into global mobilisation planning, ensuring networks are a core delivery mechanism.

• Build and maintain strategic relationships across the climate movement ecosystem and institutions, from frontline and Indigenous partners to senior external stakeholders, with sound political judgement and integrity.

• Line manages a team of two Regional Network Coordinators, setting a high bar for performance, judgement and collaboration; making sound strategic choices about partnerships, leadership development and engagement in key campaigns.

• Lead on our work and relationships with existing and new 350 affiliates applying strategic thinking and collaboration with high level relationship management.

• Build strong cross-regional collaboration and ensure lessons, tactics and political insight are shared across regions and with relevant teams.

• Ensure regional network work is fully aligned with 350.org ’s global strategy, campaign priorities and organisational standards.

• Develop and strengthen mechanisms for sharing learnings, best practices, and innovations across networks and with global teams.

• Ensure effective communication channels are in place

You are a product manager for the field, owning the technical and product direction of the engagement from initial discovery through production launch and adoption.

You will build C-suite trust, perform deep discovery to map the customer's political and technical landscape, and scope the value. You will define the Minimum Viable Product for a pilot, write the PRD that guides the engineering team, and manage the project to a successful landing. The Frontier Assurance team brings independent scrutiny into OpenAI’s safety decisions and helps the public understand and assess our safety work. We lead third-party assessments and safeguard testing for OpenAI’s flagship launches, pilot new assurance mechanisms such as embedded auditing, run our misalignment disclosure process, and incorporate independent expert input as evidence for critical safety decisions.

As a Research Program Manager on the Frontier Assurance team, you will build programs that bring independent expertise into frontier AI safety decisions and make the evidence behind those decisions understandable to the public. You will lead external research partnerships and third-party assessments, coordinate public safety documentation, and develop new approaches to independent scrutiny and transparency. title: Air Vehicle Engineer - Drone Stack
description:
Applied Intuition, Inc. is powering the future of physical AI. Founded in 2017 and now valued at $15 billion, the Silicon Valley company is creating the digital infrastructure needed to bring intelligence to every moving machine on the planet. Applied Intuition services the automotive, defense, trucking, construction, mining and agriculture industries in three core areas: tools and infrastructure, operating systems, and autonomy. Eighteen of the top 20 global automakers, as well as the United States military and its allies, trust the company’s solutions to deliver physical intelligence. Applied Intuition is headquartered in Sunnyvale, California, with offices in Washington, D.C.; San Diego; Ft. Walton Beach, Florida; Ann Arbor, Michigan; London; Stuttgart; Munich; Stockholm; Bangalore; Seoul; and Tokyo. Learn more at applied.co http://applied.co.

We are an in-office company, and our expectation is that full-time employees primarily work from their Applied Intuition office 5 days a week. However, we also recognize the importance of flexibility and trust our employees to manage their schedules responsibly. This may include occasional remote work, starting the day with morning meetings from home before heading to the office, or leaving earlier when needed to accommodate family commitments. This in-office expectation does not apply to contractor positions

ABOUT THE ROLE

As an Engineer within our Drone Stack team at Applied Intuition, you will serve as the technical anchor bridging hardware, edge software, and field flight operations. Split roughly 50/50 between the lab and the airfield, you will be responsible for bringing autonomous aerial systems from initial benchtop configuration to live operational flight.

In this role, you will configure embedded Linux environments, deploy and validate containerized software stacks, wire up mesh network topologies, and write key middleware glue code to keep subsystems communicating seamlessly. You are as comfortable with a soldering iron and oscilloscope at the bench as you are SSH-ing into an onboard computer over a mesh radio under field conditions.

This opportunity can also be located at our Drone Lab near Fort Walton Beach, Florida or at out Ann Arbor, MI office (relocation offered).

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Lead System Bring-Up: Drive end-to-end hardware and software integration for unmanned aerial systems, moving platforms from benchtop prototyping to active flight test campaigns.

- Deploy & Configure Edge Software: Manage, configure, and deploy software stacks using Docker images, shell scripts, and Linux system tools across onboard computes and peripheral hardware.

- Field & Bench Troubleshooting: Troubleshoot vehicle networks, payload interfaces, and sensor links in real time using command-line tools (grep, less, journalctl, nano/vim) and hardware diagnostics (multimeters, oscilloscopes).

- Build Test Tooling & Glue Code: Develop Python and C++ scripts for data reduction, log analysis, system validation, and real-time subsystem verification.

- System Cabling & Electronics: Fabricate custom wiring harnesses, perform precision soldering, and define system-level architecture using clear block diagrams.

- Manage Communications & Networks: Configure IP routing, subnets, and local network interfaces between flight controllers, companion computers, radios, and ground control stations.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

- Experience: 5+ years of experience in robotics integration, flight test engineering, embedded systems, or autonomous vehicles (aerial background preferred).

- Linux & Networking Mastery: Deep practical comfort with the Linux CLI, file management, system logging, local IP routing, subnets, and containerized deployments (Docker).

- Hardware & Electronics Capability: Proven hands-on skills in wiring, custom cable assembly, bench soldering, and physical diagnostics using oscilloscopes and multimeters.

- Scripting & Glue Code: Strong proficiency in Python, C++, or Shell scripting

title: Entrepreneur In Residence (MBA Graduate)
Senior UI / UX Designer
description:
Astrid is a gaming studio that brings together accomplished world builders and game developers to create multiplayer creative experiences. Our first project is a cooperative open-world sim, designed to foster connection, problem-solving and shared discovery. Players embark on a profound social experience in a richly imagined world shaped by dynamic systems, immersive storytelling and community-driven play.
Our team spans the US, the UK and beyond. We are taking a fully remote approach, but have regular in-person meetups to synchronize, huddle and build our culture.

We are currently seeking a Senior UI/UX Designer to become a vital part of our team. A huge amount of this game lives in its UI - inventory, crafting, building, decorating and dialogue - alongside the tools and items players use to explore the world, solve problems and meet the creatures in it. You will own that player-facing experience end to end, working closely with a UI engineer and guiding outsourced graphic designers.
WHO YOU ARE
Above all, we’re looking for someone with solid gaming experience who cares about UX - not just how things look, but how they work and how they feel. The brief is broad appeal, but with layers of optional depth: a low floor and a high ceiling, where the floor stays low as the ceiling rises. It’s easy to allow the depth for advanced players to complicate things for everyone; we want the opposite, complexity players discover and opt into rather than have forced upon them. Simple shouldn’t mean sterile, though: we love the small animations and satisfying feedback that give a UI charm, the Nintendo-like sense of play that makes it a pleasure to use.
If you can make something rich for experts, welcoming to newcomers and a joy to use, you’re who we’re looking for.
In order of priority, the skills we're looking for are:

• UX - Making the game simple to pick up but deep to master. This matters most, by a clear margin

• Unreal (UMG) - Able to implement your own designs in-engine, working alongside a UI engineer

• Graphic Design - A strong visual sense is a bonus rather than a requirement

WHAT YOU WILL DO

• Own the UX across the game's core systems: flows, information architecture, interaction and layout

• Design the HUD, menus, screens and moment-to-moment input so they read clearly and feel great to use

• Produce wireframes, prototypes and mock-ups and take them through to final implementation

• Build and wire up your UI in Unreal (UMG), working alongside a UI engineer

• Define and maintain a UI design system that the team and external vendors can build to

• Direct outsourced graphic designers on iconography, colour and visual polish

• Run playtests and iterate quickly as the game evolves

Requirements

• 5+ years designing UI/UX for games, with at least one shipped title or substantial in-development work

• A strong portfolio of UI/UX work on systems-rich games that shows your process and thinking

• Proven ability to make complex systems simple and intuitive without flattening their depth

• Demonstrable understanding of cosy / life-sim / management games and adventure games, since you'll be designing a hybrid of the two

• Hands-on experience building UI in Unreal (UMG). We'll consider an exceptional UX candidate with lighter Unreal, but some practical experience here is strongly expected

• Fluency with Figma and / or Adobe Suite

Benefits

• Great compensation package and equity

• Private health insurance

• Pension

• Unlimited vacation days. We trust our team!

• Flexible remote work hours as long as team members deliver results

• We are committed to continuing to expand our benefits and perks to support our team

title: Commercial & IP Legal Lead | Head Office
description:
Hi!

We are Boosta , a holding tech company that creates, develops, and invests in digital businesses with global potential. Today, we collaborate with over 800 specialists from different parts of the world, and millions of users use our products and services.

Our Legal Team is looking for a Commercial & IP Lead - a lawyer who gets genuinely irritated when a contract takes a week to get signed.
Most lawyers read contracts. You will redesign how contracts happen. Our ambition is simple to say and hard to do: a typical agreement signed within about an hour, with the overwhelming majority of the flow running automatically - templates, playbooks, CLM, e-signature, AI - and lawyers touching only the deals that truly deserve a lawyer. You'll lead the Commercial & IP pillar of the legal department, own the contract lifecycle end-to-end across dozens of business teams, and turn "waiting for legal" from an office meme into ancient history.
WHAT YOU’LL DO:

• Lead the Commercial & IP pillar of the legal department and manage its team.

• Own the full contract lifecycle for the group: intake, triage, drafting, negotiation, execution, storage.

• Standardize the contract base: templates, playbooks, and self-service routes for low-risk agreements.

• Drive contract-process automation as a flagship project - target state: a typical contract signed within about an hour, with the large majority of volume routed fully automatically and only the most significant agreements handled manually.

• Define and hold SLAs for contract turnaround; report throughput and bottlenecks.

• Manage IP portfolio matters: trademarks, domains, licensing and assignment chains.

• Coordinate handoffs with the Regulatory & Compliance and Corporate & Transactions pillars; escalate material risks to the Head of Legal.

• Act as the legal-side owner in cross-functional automation work with the AI/development team.

WHAT WE EXPECT FROM YOU:

• Strong contract drafting and negotiation in English: B2B service, SaaS/subscription, marketing and affiliate, vendor/procurement, licensing, and IP-related agreements.

• Ability to design and maintain contract templates, clause libraries, and negotiation playbooks (standard positions + fallbacks + escalation triggers).

• Contract process design end-to-end: intake → triage → drafting → approval → signature → storage, with clear SLAs and delegation rules (what needs a lawyer vs. what runs on self-service).

• Hands-on experience with CLM and e-signature tools (selection, implementation, or administration) and ticket-based intake (e.g., Jira).

• Practical use of AI tools for contract review and drafting; ability to define requirements for automating legal workflows together with a development team.

• Working knowledge of IP in commercial context: assignments, licensing, trademarks, domains.

• Understanding of data-protection touchpoints in commercial contracts (DPAs, cross-border transfer mechanics) sufficient to coordinate with the compliance team.

YOUR JOURNEY WITH US:

• Step 1: Pre-screen.

• Step 2: Technical interview.

• Step 3: Test task.

• Step 4: Final interview.

• Step 5: Reference check.

• Step 6: Job Offer!

WHAT WE OFFER

• 28 business days of paid time off.

• Flexible hours and the possibility to work remotely.

• Medical insurance and mental health care.

• Compensation for courses, trainings.

• English classes and speaking clubs.

• Internal library, educational events.

• Outstanding corporate parties, teambuildings.

title: Intern, Software Engineering (Summer 2027)
description:

Rivet is an American company building integrated task systems - fusing hardened hardware with software, sensors, AI, and networking - for industrial workforces and defense personnel. We create capabilities that multiply the effectiveness of every individual and withstand the world’s toughest environments.

We serve the people who build, operate, maintain, and defend our way of life. From technicians and engineers to first responders and service members, they embody the hard work, ingenuity, and meritocratic values that drive Western prosperity. Yet too often they are forced to rely on outdated tools that fail under modern pressures. Rivet exists to reset that priority.

At Rivet, you’ll join a mission-driven team that fuses disciplines to deliver decisive outcomes where they matter most. Whether shaping our technology, strengthening our partnerships, or building our culture, every role here contributes to equipping the front lines with the modern systems they deserve.

Work Authorization Requirement: Due to the nature of our business and compliance with federal regulations, all candidates must be a "U.S. Person". Upon hire, you will be required to provide documentation verifying your status as a U.S. Citizen, a lawful permanent resident, or a protected individual under 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3).

Summary

Join Rivet’s software engineering team in San Jose for a hands-on summer internship working on software that runs at the edge and interfaces directly with hardware. You’ll work primarily in lower-level languages such as C++ and C#, building and testing systems across perception, computer vision, sensor fusion, and edge machine learning. This is an opportunity to work on real products and challenging technical problems at the intersection of software, AI, and hardware.

Responsibilities

- Develop, test, and debug C++ and C# software for edge and hardware-integrated systems.

- Contribute to systems involving perception, computer vision, sensor fusion, or edge ML.

- Build and evaluate software on real hardware, diagnose issues, and improve system performance and reliability.

- Collaborate with software, hardware, and other engineering teams to bring features from development through testing and deployment.

Requirements

- Currently enrolled in an undergraduate or graduate program in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field.

- Available to work 40 hours per week in our San Jose, CA office during Summer 2027.

- Strong programming experience in C++, C#, or another lower-level programming language, with a willingness to work close to hardware.

- Strong interest in at least one of perception, computer vision, sensor fusion, or edge machine learning.

- U.S. Person eligible to work on Rivet’s programs and technology.

Compensation may vary within the posted range based on relevant experience, skills, education, and other job-related factors. In addition to base salary, this role may be eligible for equity and other forms of compensation. Eligible employees also receive a competitive benefits package, including unlimited PTO.

Rivet is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to any characteristic protected by applicable law. Certain roles may require U.S. Person status, security clearance eligibility, or other requirements imposed by law or government contract.

title: Senior Sales Manager (Shopify) (m/w/d)
description:
hey du :)

Eshop Guide ist eine der bekanntesten Shopify-Agenturen im deutschsprachigen Raum - nicht wegen Buzzwords, sondern weil wir seit Jahren tun, was andere nur versprechen: komplexe Shops erfolgreich auf Shopify migrieren und sie danach strategisch weiterentwickeln.
Unser Ruf im Markt beruht auf starken Case Studies, ehrlicher Beratung, tiefem Know-how und einem Team, das sich gegenseitig den Rücken freihält.
Mit uns zu verkaufen heißt: Du verkaufst Qualität, kein Wunschdenken.
Wir suchen jemanden, der Lust hat, diese Phase mitzugestalten.
deine mission

Du wirst die zentrale kommerzielle Stimme in unserem Shopify-Sales-Prozess.
Keine Kaltakquise. Keine PowerPoint-Heavy Politics.
Stattdessen:

• Du übernimmst ab SQL (Inbound, Partner, Event): Qualifizierung, Discovery, Pitch-Lead, Dealführung.

• Du orchestrierst unsere Consultants, Tech-Spezialisten und Partner und führst Kund:innen durch komplexe Entscheidungen.

• Du stellst glaubwürdige Preisbänder und Entscheidungsrahmen her - wir bauen keine Luftschlösser.

• Du sorgst dafür, dass Kunden vertrauen, verstehen und unterschreiben, weil sie merken: Du weißt, wovon du redest.

• Du arbeitest eng mit Shopify, ERP/PIM-Integratoren und App-Partnern zusammen - Co-Selling ist ein fester Bestandteil deiner Arbeit.

• Du baust die Sales-Motion weiter mit auf, statt nur in bestehende Prozesse zu passen.

Kurz: Du wirst unser Gesicht im Markt, unsere Stimme im Pitch und der Katalysator für den nächsten Wachstumsschritt.

das bringst du mit:

• 5-8+ Jahre Erfahrung in Commerce-Sales (inkl. Shopify-Sales)

• Mehrjährige Shopify-Erfahrung (Agentur oder Inhouse), genug Tiefe, um souverän beraten zu können.

• Erfahrung mit komplexen E-Commerce-Projekten (Migration, B2B, ERP/PIM-Integrationen).

• Starke Moderations- und Präsentationsfähigkeiten.

• Du kannst Preisindikationen realistisch setzen, ohne überzuversprechen.

• Deutsch auf C1-Niveau; Englisch im professionellen Kontext sicher.

• Reisebereitschaft für Pitches, Partner-Events und Teamtreffen.

Für uns leider unpassend: reine Hunter ohne Tech-/Shopify-Verständnis, oder reine Projektmanager:innen ohne Sales-Drive. Diese Rolle ist ideal für dich, wenn du...

• schon Deals >150k geclosed hast,

• nicht nur verkaufen willst, sondern echte Lösungen anbieten,

• gerne zwischen Business, Tech und Kunden navigierst,

• Spaß daran hast, Deals sauber zu strukturieren,

• und einen Ort suchst, an dem du nicht nur eine Nummer bist , sondern aktiv Zukunft baust.

Bei uns bekommst du Verantwortung ab Tag 1 - aber mit einem Team aus Consultants und Partnern, die dich stark machen.

was bieten wir dir?

• Remote-first, flexible Arbeitszeiten, echte Eigenverantwortung.

• Ein Umfeld, das pull statt push arbeitet: starke Cases, starke Reputation, starke Partner.

• Ein Team, das dir im Pitch den Rücken stärkt statt dich allein zu lassen.

• Große Gestaltungsfreiheit: Wir wachsen - und du kannst bestimmen, wie wir verkaufen.

• Ein Setup, das dir erlaubt, sichtbar zu werden: LinkedIn, Events, Partner-Ökosystem.

• Benefits wie Jobrad und -ticket, vermögenswirksame Leistungen, betriebliche Altersvorsorge, Urban Sports-Mitgliedschaft, Mental Health Plattform und noch mehr!

title: Enterprise Account Executive
description:

Our Company

VergeSense is the world's leading Workplace AI platform. We help Fortune 500 enterprises transform static real estate portfolios into highly optimized, dynamic environments. Powered by our proprietary Large Spatial Model (LSM), our Meridian Platform unifies Wi-Fi, badge, booking systems, and spatial sensor networks to shift corporate real estate (CRE) from reactive reporting to AI-driven predictive planning. Our clients use VergeSense to drive quantifiable outcomes, such as multi-million dollar lease avoidances and optimized facilities footprints.

The Opportunity

We are seeking an outcomes-focused, deeply consultative Enterprise Account Executive to drive net-new business within our highest-value accounts. In this role, you will not sell software features; you will sell business transformations, financial optimization, and employee experience strategies. You will partner with C-level executives (Chief Real Estate Officers, CFOs, and CIOs) to uncover hidden millions in underutilized real estate assets and structure complex enterprise agreements mapped directly to client-side ROI.

You'll open conversations by asking about the space decisions a customer faces in the next 12 months, then work out how they make those decisions today and how confident they are in them. Only then do you bring the right mix of platform, data, and services to fit their situation. You'll sell to real estate, workplace, facilities, and planning leaders, and you'll often be competing against the status quo: a broker, a consultant, or an internal team doing the math by hand.

• Maintain Pipeline Rigor: Consistently hit quarterly and annual revenue targets through disciplined pipeline management, accurate forecasting, and a strong land-and-expand strategy.

• Track Record: Verifiable history of continuous quota overachievement (Top 10% of the team).

Preferred

• Background selling into Corporate Real Estate (CRE), PropTech, Integrated Workplace Management Systems (IWMS), Smart Building architecture, or high-value Enterprise Infrastructure SaaS.

title: Senior Frontend Engineer - Trading Platform (Europe, Remote)
description:
About GoCharting

GoCharting is a web-native charting and trading workflow platform with institutional-grade orderflow and DOM tools - footprint/cluster charts, volume/market profile, cumulative delta, imbalance charts, and DOM trading. GoCharting is the only platform that delivers these capabilities fully on the web. It is comparable to TradingView for general charting, but differentiated as the leader in the professional orderflow niche. The company is PE-acquired and funded as of 2025, is profitable, has 3M+ registered traders globally, and has a mandate to scale 10x over 4 years.
The Role
You will own features and reliability in GoCharting 's next-gen web terminal: a real-time multi-chart trading workspace and dense market UI. The work spans product features, performance, state and sync correctness, and production incident fixes raised by active traders.
What You'll Do

• Design and ship end-to-end features in the production terminal, and keep combine/parity paths aligned when needed

• Debug hard multi-tab, hydrate, and persistence races

• Improve performance on large lists and busy charts - virtualization, subscription lifecycle, and avoiding expensive Redux churn

• Collaborate with the product and design teams on UX

• Write clear PRs, and communicate risk on sync, auth, and adjacent broker paths

• Mentor the team - raise the bar on React patterns, state boundaries, and “fix the cause, not the symptom”

What We're Looking For
Must-Haves

• 5+ years shipping complex React SPAs - hooks-first, with comfort in legacy class components

• Strong TypeScript/JavaScript and Redux (or an equivalent global + local store architecture)

• Experience with realtime / high-frequency UI - websockets, live lists, charting, trading, or similar

• Proven debugging of cross-window state, persistence, or multi-store sync bugs

• Comfort in a large monorepo - webpack, shared packages, long-lived feature branches

• Clear written communication with product and peers

Nice-to-Haves

• Chart products, market data, or broker integrations

• Canvas/SVG/WebGL charting, WASM, transpilation

• Virtualized lists (react-window etc.) and Emotion/styled UI systems

• Vitest/Jest, and Bitbucket/GitHub workflows

title: Senior Application Security Researcher
description:
Description
The company secures the AI-driven SDLC from prompt to production, unifying development and cloud context to stop vulnerabilities at the source. The Security Research group is hiring a senior, hands-on Application Security Researcher to push modern AppSec forward - working with engineers, researchers and AI/data scientists on next-generation detection, including autonomous, agentic pen-testing capabilities. This is a build-and-break role, not a typical AppSec position.
Requirements
Must-have skills:

• 5+ years hands-on in offensive security, vulnerability research, or application security

• Deep understanding of web application and API vulnerabilities, including business-logic flaws and multi-step attack chains

• Strong coding in Python, Go, or similar, with production-quality code shipped

title: Legal Intern (m/f/d)
description:
ÜBER BUENA

Buena baut Technologie, die Hausverwaltung einfacher und transparenter macht. Dafür übernehmen wir Hausverwaltungen in ganz Deutschland und entwickeln gemeinsam mit ihren Teams die Abläufe weiter. Wir verbinden Erfahrung vor Ort mit eigener Software, die im Alltag Arbeit abnimmt. Mit jeder weiteren Verwaltung wachsen auch die Anforderungen an unsere Prozesse - und genau hier kommst du ins Spiel.

DEINE ROLLE

Als Legal Operations & Compliance Intern sorgst du gemeinsam mit unserem Legal Counsel dafür, dass Buena auch bei schnellem Wachstum rechtlich und organisatorisch gut aufgestellt ist. Du bringst Ordnung in Dokumente und offene Themen unserer Holding und Hausverwaltungen und setzt rechtliche Anforderungen gemeinsam mit unseren Teams in konkrete Abläufe um.

Du übernimmst eigene, klar abgegrenzte Aufgaben und arbeitest direkt mit Legal und unseren operativen Teams zusammen. Rechtliche Bewertungen und Entscheidungen liegen bei unserem Legal Counsel; du schaffst die Informationsgrundlage und bringst die Umsetzung voran.

Du musst dafür kein Jura studieren und kein juristisches Vorwissen mitbringen. Ob du aus Business, Operations, Finance oder einem anderen analytischen Bereich kommst: Entscheidend ist, dass du schnell verstehst, sorgfältig arbeitest und Dinge zum Abschluss bringst. Den rechtlichen Kontext lernst du bei uns.

WAS DU BEI UNS MACHST

- Überblick schaffen: Du erfasst Verträge, Genehmigungen und Nachweise unserer Gesellschaften und machst sichtbar, welche Informationen vorliegen und was noch fehlt.

- Themen voranbringen: Du beschaffst Unterlagen, stimmst dich mit unseren Teams und Hausverwaltungen ab und hältst offene Punkte bis zur Klärung nach. Bei Bedarf arbeitest du dafür auch vor Ort mit den Teams.

- Prüfungen und Umsetzung vorbereiten: Du bereitest Informationen für unseren Legal Counsel auf, koordinierst vereinbarte Compliance-Maßnahmen und dokumentierst den Fortschritt.

- Abläufe verbessern: Du entwickelst gemeinsam mit Legal einfache Standards, Übersichten und Workflows für wiederkehrende Aufgaben.

Ein Beispiel: Du erstellst eine Übersicht der benötigten Nachweise mehrerer Hausverwaltungen, klärst mit den Teams fehlende Unterlagen und entwickelst mit Legal einen Ablauf, mit dem die Übersicht künftig aktuell bleibt.

WAS DU MITBRINGST

- Du bringst Dinge zum Abschluss: Du gehst Aufgaben selbstständig an, klärst offene Fragen und bleibst dran.

- Du behältst den Überblick: Auch bei vielen Dokumenten, Gesellschaften und offenen Themen arbeitest du strukturiert.

- Du arbeitest sorgfältig: Du prüfst Informationen, erkennst Widersprüche und gehst Unklarheiten nach.

- Du weißt, wann du Rücksprache brauchst: Du arbeitest eigenständig und holst dir bei Unsicherheit rechtzeitig Unterstützung.

- Du kommunizierst klar: Du hältst Absprachen ein, berichtest über Fortschritte und sprichst Hindernisse früh an.

- Du nutzt Technologie sicher: Du arbeitest mit Excel oder Google Sheets und gängigen KI-Tools.

- Du sprichst fließend Deutsch und sehr gutes Englisch.

WAS DU BEI UNS LERNST UND BEWEGEN KANNST

- Direkt mit Legal arbeiten: Du bekommst unmittelbares Feedback von unserem Legal Counsel und lernst, wie rechtliche Anforderungen im operativen Geschäft umgesetzt werden.

- Eigene Verantwortung übernehmen: Du betreust Aufgaben vom ersten Überblick bis zum Abschluss. Wenn du gute Arbeit machst, wächst deine Verantwortung.

- Ergebnisse schaffen, die bleiben: Die Standards und Abläufe, an denen du mitarbeitest, helfen den Teams unserer gesamten Gruppe.

Wir arbeiten gemeinsam im Büro, stimmen uns direkt ab und legen Wert darauf, einander gut zu kennen.

DEINE BENEFITS

- Bis zu 500 € Close-to-Office-Bonus, wenn du in Büronähe wohnst.

- 110 € Lunch-Budget und 50 € Fitness-Zuschuss pro Monat.

- 1.200 € Weiterbildungsbudget pro Jahr, anteilig.

- Kostenlose Bücher: Buena bezahlt jedes Buch, das du lesen möchtest

Location: Remote

About BEC Legal Systems

BEC Legal Systems has served the legal community for decades, evolving from its roots in Cincinnati, Ohio into a trusted provider of enterprise software for law firms and corporate legal departments nationwide. Our BEC CoreRelate Framework - including MatterLink, Docket Enterprise, LegalBar, and Assemble-It - helps legal teams manage attorney calendars, track matters, and automate document creation directly within the Microsoft Office environment they already rely on.
Our clients stay with us because our team knows their firms, their workflows, and their deadlines. As we modernize our support organization - new tooling, a real knowledge base, and AI woven into how the work gets done - we are hiring a leader to own that function and make responsiveness a competitive advantage.
About the Role

As Customer Support Manager, you will lead BEC's Support team and own the client experience from the moment a request arrives through to resolution. You may come to this from software support, or have experience working as a docket manager or specialist, paralegal, legal assistant, or legal technology coordinator who lived in systems like ours. You will define how we classify, prioritize, escalate, and measure support work - while carrying a queue yourself.
This is deliberately a hands-on leadership role, roughly half player and half coach. You will personally handle Tier 1 and Tier 2 inquiries across our product suite and refine the team’s processes and infrastructure: SLA targets, escalation path into R&D, a trusted knowledge base, and a working cadence with R&D and Cloud Ops. You will also lead the evaluation of the existing system of record for support.

• Troubleshoot and resolve: Diagnose functional and technical issues, reproduce defects, and collaborate with R&D and Cloud Ops on anything that needs engineering involvement.

• Escalate where needed: Serve as the escalation point for the team's most complex or most sensitive client situations, including issues raised by firm administrators, IT directors, and managing partners.

• Communicate under pressure: Keep clients informed during outages, defects, and long-running issues, maintaining consistent communication with clients.

Team Leadership, Process, and Systems (approximately 50%)

• SLA Definition and Tracking: Establish baseline response and resolution targets by severity, develop the appropriate tracking mechanisms, report against it weekly, and revise the targets as required.

• Escalation Path to R&D: Document and operationalize a formal escalation process into R&D - entry criteria, required information, ownership, and expected turnaround creating a defined workflow.

• Support Systems Evaluation: Lead the evaluation of the support system of record, including needs assessment, identification of the right vendor based on the businesses’ requirements, workflow configuration, implementation of a new system, and team training and change management.

title: Forensic Collision Investigator - Complex Injury
description:
Are you a Forensic Collision Investigator looking for your next challenge?

We are delighted to invite applications from experienced professionals who are keen to join our nationally recognised Catastrophic and Complex Injury Team . Led by Liz Jones , our industry-leading team comprises 30 partners and 81 lawyers based across the United Kingdom. This role offers an excellent opportunity to further develop your expertise and advance your career while working alongside some of the leading specialists in this field. Our national team acts for a diverse range of clients, including major insurers and well-known corporate organisations. We provide strategic and effective claims solutions in some of the most severe and complex cases, including traumatic brain injuries, spinal injuries, amputations, and high-value fatal accident claims. Whether instructed at the pre-litigation stage for early advice and investigation, or during active litigation, our focus is always on delivering clear, commercially focused strategies from the outset.

As a Forensic Collision Investigator , you will work closely with our Complex Injury lawyers to investigate high-value personal injury claims arising from road traffic collisions. The role involves gathering, analysing and interpreting evidence relating to collisions, as well as providing expert insight into liability issues to support our case strategy. We are seeking an individual with significant experience in collision investigation who can bring a forensic and analytical approach to complex claims. The successful candidate is likely to have previously worked as a Forensic Collision Investigator and will have extensive experience investigating road traffic accidents and assessing the evidence arising from them. What you will do?

• To help obtain evidence in civil cases arising out of road traffic collisions.

• To help secure witness evidence.

• To provide an expert analysis of road traffic accidents, to be used for internal purposes, in respect of the liability issues in civil claims.

• Interpret evidence secured, identifying and advising on accuracy and sufficiency of third-party evidence (such as the police collision investigation), to include liaising with police, CPS, and coroners.

• Undertake site inspections of accident locations.

• The successful candidate will need strong communication skills as they will be interacting with a broad spectrum of internal and external stakeholders. Internally they will be required to work collegiately with case handlers at all levels as well as other support colleagues. Externally the Role Holder will be required to interact with witnesses, Police and other emergency personnel, Coroners, recovery agents, the general public and our insurer clients.

Who you are

• Significant experience as a Collision Investigator, likely with a UK police force, having investigated a broad range of road traffic collisions.

• Relevant professional qualifications would be very useful, in particular the minimum of UCPD in Forensic Road Collision

• Investigation or the City and Guilds Certificate in Police Forensic Collision Investigation.

• Some insight into civil proceedings and the interaction with police investigations and criminal proceedings.

• Empathy and compassion to help guide our clients through challenging personal circumstances.

• A friendly, enthusiastic and can-do approach.
